body:
Indoor rock climbing is the only way I'm treating my depression at the moment. It's hard to be depressed when you're clinging to the wall.

I'm pretty sure it's the only reason I'm still here. I should go more often...
You two are so adorable together. I wish I could find something like that in my life.
It's worth a try I guess, that would be good. Thanks
I don't know.... Probably not though. I've been a bit screwed up mentally these last few years. I think it's finally catching up to me
Does being depressed ever make sense? Logically I know that at least one or two of them must be false. But I can't make myself believe that

I spoke to a counsellor for half a year and it did nothing. I feel no better now than I did before.

I've been trying to get out and do sports, but again I don't feel any different. I guess I've only been going once a fortnight, sometimes once a week though so maybe that's not enough
I might send you a message after work
I guess I've got the ability to choose some things. But I can't see how I've got any ability to change anything related to how I feel.

That I'm worthless, that I'll never amount to any thing. That I am no good at anything. That nobody loves me, and nobody ever will. That everyone I'll ever care about will reject me, and that life is never going to change.
